title: Data-quality and ethics review of six recordings before a group analysis
objective: Assign each of six de-identified fMRI/EEG recordings a readiness status from the neurosci quality gates and the IRB/consent gate before they enter a group analysis.

decision_questions.positive_despite_block: Does any recording whose consented scope does not cover group_analysis, or that fails a modality quality gate, still receive ready or ready_with_caveats?
decision_questions.boundary_misread: Does the result exclude or flag REC-02 even though its FD 0.50 mm, censored fraction 20% and tSNR 40.0 sit exactly on thresholds that pass?

traps.REC-02: Boundary: FD 0.50 mm, censored 0.20 and tSNR 40.0 are all exactly on threshold; validateFMRI uses strict > / < so all pass: ready.
traps.REC-03: Passes EEG gates (121 μV, 83%) and IRB is valid, but expires 2026-11-20, inside the 30-day warn window: ready_with_caveats, not ready.
traps.REC-04: Epoch acceptance 81% looks fine, but peak amplitude 162 μV exceeds the 150 μV reject gate: exclude.
traps.REC-05: Best signal in the batch (88 μV, 94% epochs, valid protocol ID) but consented scope is single_subject_clinical_review, which does not contain group_analysis: irb_scope fails, blocked.
traps.REC-06: Mean FD 0.31 mm and tSNR 61.7 look good, but 27% censored frames exceeds the 20% gate: exclude.
